title: Reboot! Off to the World of Adventure!!
overview: Now that their adventure in Rakua is over, Liko and the others have just been sitting around absentmindedly without doing much of anything. However, one day Friede visits them and invites them along for some fieldwork to investigate an amazing Pokémon. That Pokémon turns out to be a Hinbass...

title: Enter the Fake Rising Volteccers!?
overview: News of the Rising Volt Tacklers helping people has become the talk of the town all over... however, Liko and the others have absolutely no idea what these stories are referring to. Could there be impostors around...? The group head off to investigate in order to find out what's going on... and believe it or not, while they're asking around for information, they discover a second Brave Asagi?! Just who are the Fake Rising Volt Tacklers...?

title: The Secret Metamon Rhapsody
overview: Laudbon and the others are starving, but as they search for berries, a Metamon who's tried to Transform into Cap appears before them. The naive and childlike Metamon quickly befriends the Pokémon from the airship, however...

title: Clap Clap Clap! Mini Gurumin!!
overview: Metamon crashes one of Gurumin's livestreams after having tried to Transform into her. Dot gets upset about this and wants to pretend it never happened, but the "Mini-Gurumin" incident actually becomes quite the talk of of town in her fandom... so Dot decides to take Metamon along for the bread festival she's been invited to hold a show at...

title: READY GO! Unite Battle!!
overview: Liko and the others land on Aeos Island! There, Liko, Roy, Dot, Uruto and Friede will try their hands at a Unite Battle!

title: Miare City! New Encounters
overview: Liko and the others have arrived in Miare City,and go visit the Handsome House, where they meet Matiere and her assistant Navi. Navi really loves Pokémon,and takes a great interest in Liko and the others. Just then, Matiere receives a request to locate a Melecie. And when the group starts investigating, they learn that a large blonde man wearing a dougi was accompanying it.

title: A Dream Ball for You!
overview: Navi is really depressed due to losing the Dream Ball. It was really dear to her, as she had been given it by Matiere so that she'd one day use it to catch hold of her dream... Meanwhile, Metamon picks up the Dream Ball Navi dropped on the airship and decides to head off to Miare City all by itself in order to return it to her...! Will Metamon be able to find Navi and return the Dream Ball safe and sound?!

title: Navi's Little Big Adventure!
overview: Navi has got Metamon and become a member of the Rising Volt Tacklers! The upfront and enthusiastic Navi immediately hits it off with the rest of the crew, but just doesn't seem to click with Uruto... Liko suggests the two of them run an errand in the nearby town, but as expected, they end up fighting again! But when Navi goes off on her own, she ends up getting lost?!

title: Shocking! Mega Rayquaza and the Mysterious Land!?
overview: The mystical land of Area Delta is said to have a terrifying Pokémon that abducts trespassers into another world... and it's a Mega Rayquaza?! Pokémon journalist Sohdayo invites Liko and the others along to ascertain the truth... however, they're faced with one mysterious, unnatural phenomenon after another...?!

title: Wanival and Dekanuchan's Great Sleep Operation!
overview: Just as Wanival and Dekanuchan are suffering from sleep deprivation, Liko and the others run into Professor Neroli, a researcher of Pokémon sleeping. They all travel together to Wakakusa Island to try using the power of the Kabigon there to put Wanival and Dekanuchan to sleep, but the hungry Kabigon ends up waking up... and the group starts working on trying to make Comatose Butter Curry in order to fill it up and make it go back to sleep!!

title: Crazy Feels! This Is a Pokémon Contest, Dearie!!
overview: Liko decides to enter a Pokémon Contest with Masquernya, Laudbon and Wanival! And after getting trained by the self-styled "coach" Navi, it's finally time for the real deal! The venue is filled with skilled performers, last but not least the Pikachu idol group "Cutie Pikapika", and Liko starts feeling quite uneasy as she watches them perform...

title: Koraidon & Miraidon! The Great Paldea Race!!
overview: One day Liko and the others go watch a Mototokage race, where Liko ends up encountering a Miraidon and Roy ends up encountering a Koraidon. The two mistake these Pokémon for Mototokage and befriend them by feeding them, but when Koraidon and Miraidon hear the sounds of the race, they break into a dash... and Liko and Roy somehow end up entering the race as a result.

title: A Squishy Pokemon! If You Squish It and It Squishes, It's Squishy Time
overview: Liko and Navi visit a cafe to try a Metamon collab menu they're offering. There they encounter Yakata, an office worker with a Namakobushi and a Yukihami on his shoulders and a Bachinuni on his head. Yakata explains how he loves squishiness more than anything, and invites Liko and the others to to try "SquishyPoké Activities", or "SquiPoActs" for short; Activities all about loving and cherishing squishy Pokémon.

title: The Expanding World, GO with You!
overview: Liko and the others get invited to join Friede on some fieldwork of his, where they're also accompanied by Professor Willow, a professor traveling the world to research Pokémon! As they conduct their research, Liko and the others ask Friede how he and Lizardon first met. It turns out that this happened while Friede was still a kid and Lizardon was a Hitokage... and it's now time to reveal that story.
